root_cause: The legal center candidate follows the descending backbone too long, then overshoots below the flower and returns through an almost vertical terminal segment. It reads as a routed connector instead of a growing support branch.
proposed_change: Preserve the derived remote root and underside target, rotate the departure farther toward the open flower-side corridor, flatten the lower sweep, and place the last guide anchor left and slightly below the flower contact so the terminal approach rises diagonally into the underside.
